channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Peter Storey, xiddigii Arsenal ee koobabka labada ah ku guuleystay 1971, oo ku geeriyooday 81 jir
item.description: Kubbad-yaqaankii hore ee Arsenal iyo xulka England, Peter Storey, ayaa ku geeriyooday da'da 81 jir, sida uu Talaadadii shaaciyay naadiga Arsenal.

item.title: War culus: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo si aan horay loo arag u weeraray Imaaraadka Carabta – “Faragelintiisa waa khatar ku soo wajahan qarannimada Soomaaliya”
item.description: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa khudbad uu caawa u jeediyay shacabka ku eedeeyay Imaaraadka Carabta inuu faragelin toos ah ku hayo arrimaha gudaha Soomaaliya, isla markaana uu wiiqayo midnimada iyo madax-bannaanida dalka.

item.title: Tababarihii hore ee Betis Pepe Mel oo ka soo baxay qaybta daryeelka degdegga ah ee isbitaalka
item.description: Tababarihii hore ee Real Betis, Pepe Mel, ayaa ka soo baxay qaybta daryeelka degdegga ah ee Isbitaalka Virgen del Rocío ee Sevilla, kaddib istaroog uu ku dhacay 1 November, sida ay wariyeen Cadena SER iyo Mundo Deportivo.

item.title: Philippe Diallo oo Paris ka furay ololihiisa doorashada madaxtinimada FIFA ee ka dhanka ah Infantino
item.description: Guddoomiyaha Xiriirka Kubbadda Cagta Faransiiska, Philippe Diallo, ayaa Talaadadii Paris ka furay ololihiisa madaxtinimada FIFA, kaddib markii guddiga fulinta ee FFF uu ansixiyay musharaxnimadiisa.

item.title: Ciidanka Uganda oo baarlamaanka ka codsaday 1.9 trillion oo shilin si mushaarka askarta loo labalaabo
item.description: Wasaaradda Difaaca Uganda ayaa baarlamaanka u sheegtay in ciidanka UPDF ay u baahan yihiin 1.9 trillion oo shilin Uganda ah si mushaarka dhammaan askarta loogu kordhiyo 100 boqolkiiba.

item.title: LeBron James oo beeniyay warbixin ESPN oo sheegtay inuu 76ers ka codsaday dulqaad
item.description: LeBron James ayaa beeniyay warbixin uu daabacay wariyaha ESPN Dave McMenamin oo sheegtay inuu Philadelphia 76ers ka codsaday dulqaad, xilli dhibcihiisu ay yihiin kuwii ugu hooseeyay noloshiisa ciyaareed.

item.title: Madaxweyne Deni oo xarunta taliska 54-aad kula kulmay saraakiisha ciidanka Daraawiishta
item.description: Madaxweynaha Puntland Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni ayaa booqday xarunta taliska 54-aad, halkaas oo uu kula kulmay taliyaha ciidanka Daraawiishta iyo saraakiil kale, si looga wada hadlo amniga iyo la dagaalanka argagixisada iyo burcad-badeedda.

item.title: Arthur Fils oo Rafael Jodar ku garaacay, helayna guushiisii ugu horreysay ee ATP Finals
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka tennis-ka reer Faransiis, Arthur Fils, ayaa Talaadadii magaalada Turin 4-6, 6-2, 6-2 kaga adkaaday Rafael Jodar, isagoo noqday reer Faransiiskii ugu horreeyay ee ATP Finals guul ka gaara tan iyo 2011.

item.title: De Bruyne oo Allegri siiyay laba maalmood oo nasasho ah, Arbacada ayuu ku soo laabanayaa Napoli
item.description: Kevin De Bruyne ayaa Arbacada, 18 November, ku soo laabanaya xarunta tababarka Napoli ee Castel Volturno, kaddib laba maalmood oo nasasho ah oo uu la ogolaaday tababare Massimiliano Allegri.

item.title: Dustin May oo la sheegay inuu White Sox la galay heshiis saddex sano ah oo $52.5 milyan ah
item.description: Tuuraha baseball-ka Dustin May ayaa la sheegay inuu Chicago White Sox la gaaray heshiis saddex sano ah oo qiimihiisu yahay $52.5 milyan, sida ay wariyeen The Athletic iyo CBS Sports; naadigu weli si rasmi ah uma uusan shaacin.

item.title: Senegal oo noqotay xulkii ugu horreeyay ee u gudba Koobka Qaramada Afrika 2027
item.description: Senegal ayaa noqotay xulkii ugu horreeyay ee kaalin ka hela Koobka Qaramada Afrika (AFCON) 2027, kaddib markii Mozambique ay 1-0 kaga adkaatay Itoobiya.

item.title: Maxkamadda Sare ee Spain oo diiday racfaankii LaLiga, Real Madrid oo ku guuleystay kiiska CVC
item.description: Maxkamadda Sare ee Spain ayaa diiday racfaan ay LaLiga ka qaadatay xukun buriyay go'aankii 2021 ee lagu ansixiyay heshiiska maalgashiga CVC, sida uu Real Madrid ku sheegay war rasmi ah.

item.title: Diyaarad milatari oo Ruush ah oo nooca An-12 ah oo ku burburtay gobolka Kemerovo ee Siberia
item.description: Diyaarad xamuul oo milatari oo Ruush ah, oo nooca Antonov An-12 ah, ayaa Talaadadii ku burburtay meel u dhow tuulada Yagunovo ee gobolka Kemerovo ee Siberia, iyadoo warbaahinta Ruushku ay sheegayso in dhammaan dadkii saarnaa, ilaa 17 qof, ay dhinteen.

item.title: Antoine Griezmann oo loo doortay ciyaaryahanka cusub ee ugu fiican MLS 2026
item.description: Weeraryahanka Orlando City, Antoine Griezmann, ayaa Talaadadii si rasmi ah loogu dhawaaqay ciyaaryahanka cusub ee sannadka 2026 ee horyaalka MLS, isagoo noqday ciyaaryahankii ugu horreeyay ee reer Faransiis ah ee abaalmarintan hela.

item.title: Xiriirka Kubbadda Cagta England oo codsaday inuu martigeliyo finalka Nations League ee June
item.description: Xiriirka Kubbadda Cagta England (FA) ayaa UEFA u gudbiyay danaynta uu u qabo martigelinta finalka afarta kooxood ee Nations League, kaas oo dhici doona 9 ilaa 13 June 2027, iyadoo Spain iyo Faransiiska ay sidoo kale codsaday.

item.title: Lautaro Martínez oo markii ugu horreysay tan iyo dhaawiciisa la tababartay kooxda Inter
item.description: Kabtanka Inter, Lautaro Martínez, ayaa Talaadadii Appiano Gentile ku soo laabtay tababarka kooxda, kaddib dhaawac muruqa bowdada ah oo ka hor istaagay toddoba kulan.

item.title: NISA oo sheegtay inay Moqokori ku dishay horjooge ka tirsan qaybta maaliyadda Al-Shabaab
item.description: Hay'adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka (NISA) ayaa sheegtay in laba howlgal oo ay ka fulisay degmada Moqokori ee gobolka Hiiraan lagu dilay horjooge u qaabilsanaa maaliyadda Al-Shabaab, laguna dhaawacay 3 kale.

item.title: Madaxweyne Samia oo Philip Mpango u magacaabay guddoomiyaha Jaamacadda Beeraha ee Sokoine
item.description: Madaxweynaha Tanzania Samia Suluhu Hassan ayaa Madaxweyne ku-xigeenkii hore Dr Philip Mpango u magacaabay Chancellor-ka (guddoomiyaha sare) ee Jaamacadda Beeraha ee Sokoine (SUA), taasoo qayb ka ah magacaabisyo dhowr ah oo maanta lagu dhawaaqay.

item.title: Robinho Junior oo laba gool u dhaliyay Brazil U20 oo Peru ku garaacday 9-0
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka Genoa Robinho Junior, oo ah wiilka weeraryahankii hore ee Brazil Robinho, ayaa laba gool dhaliyay kulan saaxiibtinimo oo xulka Brazil ee da'da ka yar 20 jirka uu Peru kaga adkaaday 9-0.

item.title: Tiger Woods oo bisha soo socota dib ugu soo laabanaya tartamada golf-ka
item.description: Tiger Woods ayaa ka qayb geli doona tartanka Hero World Challenge ee ka dhacaya Bahamas 3 ilaa 6 December, isagoo markii ugu horreysay ciyaari doona tan iyo xarigiisii bishii March.

item.title: Alexander Zverev oo wajahaya dacwad madani ah oo cusub oo ay ka gudbisay xaaskiisii hore
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka tennis-ka Jarmalka Alexander Zverev ayaa wajahaya dacwad madani ah oo ay ka gudbisay Brenda Patea, oo ah hooyada gabadhiisa, kadib hadal uu ka sheegay kiiskii hore ee lagu eedeeyay rabshad qoys.

item.title: Daafaca Girona Mauro Furtado oo dhaawac jilibka ah awgiis xilli ciyaareedka oo dhan seegaya
item.description: Girona ayaa xaqiijisay in daafaceeda reer Portugal, Mauro Furtado, uu jilibka bidix ka qabo dhaawac culus oo xiriqyada ah, kaas oo ka saaraya inta ka dhiman xilli ciyaareedka.

item.title: Maxkamadda Sare ee Uganda oo amartay doorasho cusub oo Ururka Qareennada ah 14 maalmood gudahood
item.description: Maxkamadda Sare ee Uganda ayaa go'aamisay in muddada xilka ee golaha hoggaanka Ururka Qareennada Uganda (ULS), oo uu hoggaamiyo Isaac Ssemakadde, ay dhammaatay, waxayna amartay in shir guud iyo doorasho cusub la qabto 14 maalmood gudahood.

item.title: Mike Maignan oo baaritaan kadib laga waayay dhaawac culus, Milan oo neefsatay
item.description: Kooxda AC Milan ayaa shaacisay in baaritaanno caafimaad oo maanta lagu sameeyay goolhayaha Mike Maignan aysan muujin wax dhaawac ah oo ku yaal muruqyada gumaarka iyo bowdada gudaha.

item.title: Wayne Rooney oo sheegay inuu xilligii uu Manchester United joogay la halgamayay caafimaadka maskaxda
item.description: Kabtankii hore ee xulka England Wayne Rooney ayaa barnaamij podcast ah ku sheegay in xilli uu ciyaaryahan ka ahaa Manchester United uu la kulmay dhibaatooyin culus oo xagga caafimaadka maskaxda ah, khamri cabbid iyo go'doomin.

item.title: Ingiriiska oo cunaqabateyn saaray 8 shirkadood oo Israa'iili ah oo dhisa degsiimooyinka Daanta Galbeed
item.description: Dowladda Ingiriiska ayaa Talaadadan xayiraad hanti saartay sideed shirkadood oo dhismeed oo Israa'iili ah oo ku lug leh dhismaha degsiimooyinka Daanta Galbeed ee la haysto, iyo koox degeyaal ah oo hor istaagta gargaarka loo diro Gaza.

item.title: Sevilla oo dharbaaxo cusub la kulantay: José Ángel Carmona oo lugta ka jabay
item.description: Kooxda Sevilla ayaa Talaadadan xaqiijisay in daafaceeda José Ángel Carmona uu ka jabay lafaha tibia iyo perone ee lugta midig, kadib shil uu ku dhaawacmay tababarka.

item.title: Bryson DeChambeau oo ku biiray DP World Tour kadib burburka LIV Golf
item.description: Xiddigga golf-ka ee Mareykanka Bryson DeChambeau ayaa sannadka soo socda ku ciyaari doona DP World Tour, kadib markii LIV Golf ay ku dhawaaqday inay joojinayso hawlaheeda.

item.title: Hashim Thaçi oo lagu xukumay 17 bilood oo dheeraad ah kadib markii lagu helay faragelin markhaatiyaal
item.description: Maxkamad gaar ah oo ku taal The Hague ayaa madaxweynihii hore ee Kosovo Hashim Thaçi ku xukuntay 17 bilood oo xarig dheeraad ah, kadib markii lagu helay inuu isku dayay inuu saameeyo markhaatiyaasha xeer-ilaalinta iyo inuu faafiyay xog qarsoodi ah.

item.title: Endrick iyo xaaskiisa Gabriely oo helay ilmahoodii ugu horreeyay
item.description: Weeraryahanka reer Brazil Endrick ayaa ku dhawaaqay in xaaskiisa Gabriely ay dhashay ilmahoodii ugu horreeyay, isagoo warkan ku sheegay warbaahinta kadib kulankii Brazil iyo Singapore.
